title: Quasi-coherent algebra descent data on all scheme tests of an atlas relation
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with independent universes as in [def-weil-size-convention], let $F$ be a category over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ in the total-category convention of [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids], let $U$ be an $S$-scheme and let $a:h_U\to F$ be a functor over $\mathit{Sch}/S$. The discrete fibred category $h_U$ has objects $f:T\to U$ and arrows the commuting scheme triangles; it is fibred in groupoids. On its big fppf site, with regular-function structure sheaf [def-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-algebra], transport the structure sheaf by the canonical sectionwise $\mathrm{ULift}$ of [def-pur-cochain-coefficient-universe-transport] to the common ambient coefficient universe. An atlas algebra $C$ is a commutative algebra over that sheaf whose underlying module is quasi-coherent in the local-presentation sense of [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], with all structure-preserving algebra maps. By [lem-sfb-stack-quasi-coherent-scheme-restriction] this is the big-site encoding of an ordinary quasi-coherent algebra on $U$ and its tensor pullbacks. Define an atlas algebra descent datum to be such a $C$, together with, for every $S$-scheme $T$, maps $f,g:T\to U$, and isomorphism $i:a(f)\simeq a(g)$ over $1_T$, a ring isomorphism $\delta_i:C(T,f)\simeq C(T,g)$ preserving the regular functions of $T$. For $b:T'\to T$ and a vertical isomorphism $j:a(fb)\simeq a(gb)$ whose square with $i$ and the cartesian arrows commutes, require $\delta_j\,\mathrm{res}_{b,f}=\mathrm{res}_{b,g}\,\delta_i$. Require $\delta_{1_{a(f)}}=1$ and $\delta_{ji}=\delta_j\delta_i$ for all composable vertical isomorphisms. Thus when the relation is an algebraic space these are exactly the scheme-test expressions of the isomorphism $p_1^*C\simeq p_2^*C$, its diagonal normalization and its triple-relation cocycle. Morphisms are all atlas algebra maps $C\to D$ satisfying $\delta_D\,h_f=h_g\,\delta_C$ on every relation test; identities and composition are those of algebra maps.

source.place: Tag 06WT, proposition-quasi-coherent: the two quasi-inverse functors and the explicit presheaf on (T,u), with restriction via the inverse transition; Tags 06TV, 06WK, 06WG for regular functions and the scheme comparison. Algebra operations and their maps are transported by the same tensor-compatible comparison.

lean.note: Definition only: the underlying atlas algebra uses existing module quasi-coherence on its big fppf site, with canonical coefficient transport. Natural ring isomorphisms on every scheme point of the relation give the entire sheaf algebra isomorphism, not merely its map on global sections of U. Identity, naturality and composition laws are explicit. The sole named postponed support theorem proves that h_U is fibred in groupoids; it supplies only a proof for the existing structure-sheaf construction.
